## Profile

Neuroscientist and research software engineer passionate about open, collaborative,
and reproducible science. I build open-source tools to study brains and the behaviours
they produce, with a background in medicine and a PhD in neuroimaging.
Fellow of the [Software Sustainability Institute (SSI)](https://www.software.ac.uk/programmes/fellowship-programme)
and lead developer of [movement](https://movement.neuroinformatics.dev),
a Python package for analysing animal motion.

## Current Position

**Senior Research Software Engineer** | 2022 -- present | London, UK

- [Neuroinformatics Unit](https://neuroinformatics.dev/)
- [Sainsbury Wellcome Centre for Neural Circuits and Behaviour](https://www.sainsburywellcome.org/)
- [Gatsby Computational Neuroscience Unit](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/gatsby/)
- [University College London](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/)

Responsibilities include:

- Lead developer of [movement](https://movement.neuroinformatics.dev), a Python toolbox for analysing animal body movements
- Core contributor to [BrainGlobe](https://brainglobe.info/), an ecosystem of neuroanatomy tools
- Building new brain atlases for emerging model organisms via [brainglobe-template-builder](https://github.com/brainglobe/brainglobe-template-builder)
- Promoting open-source adoption through training workshops for early-career researchers
